notes: Pictures on shared mood boards now sync both ways, including from a Mac to a Windows PC
Pictures over 10 MB are shared as a smaller copy; your original is untouched
Cards say Image downloading or Image not downloaded while a picture is on its way
Mood board photos can be moved and zoomed inside their frame and fitted to the whole picture
Renaming a shared project syncs to everyone
Shared projects that only exist in your cloud can be fetched on another computer
